offering: Pods Secure Cloud, NVIDIA RTX A5000 24 GB, 1 GPU

provenance.price_per_client_usd: User explicitly chose USD 5/month; not estimated willingness to pay.
provenance.period_days: Explicit 30-day comparison window; 720 billed GPU hours at 24/7.
provenance.disks: Proposed provisioned configuration: 10 GB container + 20 GB persistent volume; not observed storage usage. Both storage types are billed.
provenance.monthly_storage: Nominal monthly storage quote; actual invoice is prorated per second and subject to checkout terms.

sources.supports: Secure Cloud A5000 USD 0.27/GPU-hour; Community Cloud USD 0.16/GPU-hour; availability varies by region.
Published GPU rate and container/volume running storage USD 0.10/GB/month.
Per-second GPU billing, storage charges and no data ingress/egress fees for Pods. Volume storage remains billable when stopped.
Container disk and persistent volume are separate billed resources.

scope: Public infrastructure quote, not an invoice or deployment. Same rental for Qwen or Gemma on this same single-GPU configuration. Excludes unquoted taxes, collection fees, human operation, acquisition, backups and any separately contracted service. No savings or error-cost valuation.

local_power.reason: The benchmark did not measure AC energy of the whole computer. A later idle GPU sample reported 310.33 W with no power-limit reading; this is insufficient for a defensible whole-system electricity bill. Battery discharge is also not AC input consumption.
